title: Family Memories
instructions: Think about someone in your family who makes you happy. Tell me their name and one thing you remember about them.

title: Railway Memories
instructions: Think about your railway career. Tell me one place you worked and one thing you remember from that time.

title: Time and Day
instructions: What day is it today? What month are we in? What part of the day is it?

title: Word Connection
instructions: I will say a word. Tell me another word that is related to it. Word: railway.

title: Morning Steps
instructions: Put these actions in a sensible order: have breakfast, wake up, brush your teeth, get dressed.

title: Plan Your Afternoon
instructions: Imagine you want to go for your evening walk and then have dinner. What would you need to do first?

title: Everyday Choice
instructions: It is raining outside and you planned a walk. What could you do instead?
